title: Reusable README technique combinations
summary: Help an adopter choose and adapt a pinned combination from README-Technique-Library. Keep the selection, rationale, and outcome with the project and use README HQ's drafting and verification workflow.
acceptance_criteria: From a clean adopter checkout, find eligible combinations in the external library and resolve their active technique IDs at a full library commit.
Explain each option's applicability, prerequisites, and tradeoffs. Record which combination the adopter chooses, adapts, or skips and why.
Store project-specific choices and results with the adopter. Keep reusable combination definitions on README-Technique-Library.
Record discovery, execution, and fresh-agent handoff independently with expected and observed results, the tested revisions, and explicit gaps.
Use a same-checkout relative link for supporting docs and immutable source links for claims about another revision. Retain an outcome record alongside workflow and artifact identifiers.
A command unrelated to the advertised first action cannot satisfy the execution check.

evidence.claim: The adopter's existing learning log supplies candidate technique combinations.
The public Ubuntu job verifies the documented two-version command on its pinned product revision. This is evidence for the pilot's execution check.
The owning catalog publishes the pilot's five-step combination and links the original trial, including the partial handoff.
